# IT Russia

> IT Russia is the primary source for news, analysis, and expert insights on Russian technology innovation, artificial intelligence strategy, and digital transformation across industries.

The site covers Russian tech sector developments including AI applications, robotics, software development, and regulatory frameworks. It features interviews with industry leaders and strategic analysis of Russia's technology positioning in a global context.

## Key Topics

- Russian tech sector
- Artificial intelligence
- AI strategy
- Robotics
- Software development
- Smart home technologies
- Satellite navigation systems
- AI governance
- Digital security
- Blockchain technology
- Cloud infrastructure
- IT legislation
- Digital transformation
- Open-source AI models
- Cybersecurity

## Strategic Analysis & Expert Interviews

- [Russia's AI-and-Cloud Strategy in an Era of Global Volatility (part I)](https://itrussia.media/article/russias-ai-and-cloud-strategy-in-an-era-of-global-volatility): Deep dive on Russia's AI and cloud strategy amid global market turbulence
- [Russia's AI-and-Cloud Strategy in an Era of Global Volatility (part II)](https://itrussia.media/article/chinas-ai-strategy-how-open-models-become-a-global-industria): Comparative analysis of China's open-source LLM strategy and Russian alignment
- [Russia's AI-and-Cloud Strategy in an Era of Global Volatility (part III)](https://itrussia.media/article/russias-ai-strategy-in-a-volatile-world-pragmatism-open-mode): Analysis of Russia's pragmatic AI strategy focused on open models and sovereignty

## Industry Expert Interviews

- [Alexander Goldstein: "Vibe Coding Is a New Reality That Could Reshape Software Development"](https://itrussia.media/article/alexander-goldstein-vibe-coding-is-a-new-reality-that-could-): Developer interview on AI-driven coding trends and software development evolution
- [Natalia Markova: "Our Digital Reality Has Overtaken the Visions of Sci-Fi Writers"](https://itrussia.media/article/natalia-markova-our-digital-reality-has-overtaken-the-vision): Expert interview on smart home technologies reshaping Russian residential districts
- [Sergey Lebedev: "The market does not need gadgets – it needs resilient navigation systems that actually work in real-world conditions"](https://itrussia.media/article/sergey-lebedev-the-market-does-not-need-gadgets-it-needs-res): Expert on Russian satellite navigation systems and GLONASS technology development
- [Mikhail Borisov: "From Battle of the Robots to a New Category of Urban Machines"](https://itrussia.media/article/mikhail-borisov-from-battle-of-the-robots-to-a-new-category-): Interview on remotely operated urban cleaning robots from Perm startup
